title: POST /api/v1/clusters/{cluster}/objects/{name}/health-check: result
description: The nodes' trial of an object's health check, made in this call: what the object form's Test health check shows.

document.description: Code. Which version of the object was tried: its draft, its saved change, or the one stored in the cluster.

ran.description: Value. False where nothing was tried; problem says why, and is the installation's or the object's, not a server's.

problem.description: Text. Why nothing was tried, in the interface's words; null where it ran.

source.description: Value. The address the check was made from; null where the object names none or nothing ran.

complete.description: Value. True where the trial was the whole check; false where caveats name what it did not reproduce, and where nothing ran.

caveats.description: Text. What this trial does not reproduce about the check, one sentence each.

failing.description: Value. How many servers, counted over the nodes, did not pass.

tested_at.description: Value. When the nodes were asked; null where nothing ran.

held_by.description: Value. The nodes that carry the object's source address, and so could answer.

reachable.description: Value. Whether the node answered the manager.

error.description: Text. Why the node did not answer; null where it did.

source_held.description: Value. False where the node does not carry the source address and so tried nothing; null where the node did not say.

ok.description: Value. Whether the server passed by the object's own account of a good answer.

status.description: Value. The status the server answered with (a response code for a dns check); null where there was none.

error.description: Text. Why the server did not pass; null where it did.

ms.description: Value. Milliseconds the try took; null where it did not finish.

summary.description: Text. What happened, in the interface's words, such as answered 200.

certificate.description: Value. The certificate the server presented over TLS: subject, names, issuer, not_after (ISO 8601 UTC) and version; null without TLS, where the handshake failed, or from a node older than the field.

names.description: Text. Its DNS names, at most ten.

issuer.description: Text. Who issued it: the issuer's common name, else its organization.

not_after.description: Value. When it expires, ISO 8601 UTC.

version.description: Value. The TLS version the handshake settled on, such as TLSv1.3.

verified.description: Value. Whether the pool holds the server's certificate to a CA; null for a check without TLS.
